### Remembered No More
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-october-17-2023.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 20:1
Points:
- Unlike the account in 2 Samuel, the Chronicler completely omits David's moral failure with Bathsheba.
- Because David had truly repented and received pardon, the biblical author had no need to dwell on his sin.
- Although David experienced painful earthly scars, God's grace completely wiped away his guilt.
- Believers must resist the enemy's attempts to dredge up past wrongdoing that has already been forgiven.
- Through Christ, our sins are covered by grace and no longer define our identity or eternal future.
